approaches.name: apply-upstream-pr-5063
approaches.source: https://github.com/pallets/flask/pull/5063 - Official fix by davidism merged Apr 14, 2023, closes issue #5004. Commit 84c007d34f7f0b8737310fe4d67be12c463e0130
approaches.summary: Apply the upstream fix from PR #5063 that adds subdomain/host column to flask routes output. The fix refactors routes_command() in src/flask/cli.py to detect if any routes have subdomain/host, adds a column when present, adds 'domain' sort option, and uses itemgetter for sorting.

approaches.name: minimal-subdomain-only
approaches.source: Derived from analyzing routes_command() in src/flask/cli.py at this version. Simpler approach that adds only subdomain column without full refactor or host_matching support.
approaches.summary: Add only subdomain column to routes output by extending headers tuple to include 'Subdomain', modifying widths calculation to include rule.subdomain, and updating the format string and output loop. Does not support host_matching or the 'domain' sort option.

approaches.name: apply-upstream-pr-5063-measured
approaches.summary: Apply upstream PR #5063 fix to routes_command() in src/flask/cli.py: change operator import to itemgetter, add domain sort option, detect has_domain, build rows as lists, conditionally add Subdomain/Host column, use dynamic sorting with itemgetter

approaches.measurement: Not measured - rejected based on specification analysis. Issue #5004 explicitly requests conditional display (only when subdomains exist) and host_matching support. Minimal approach would always show subdomain column and lacks host support.
approaches.name: minimal-subdomain-always-shown
approaches.source: Local code analysis of routes_command() function
approaches.summary: Add subdomain column unconditionally to all routes output by extending the static headers tuple. This violates the requirement from issue #5004 that subdomain should only be shown when at least one route uses it, and doesn't support host_matching mode.

fom.measure: Run the repository's test suite for this issue (target tests that validate subdomain display in flask routes output)

plan.detail: Change line 12 from 'from operator import attrgetter' to 'from operator import itemgetter' to support new row-based sorting approach
plan.title: Update operator import in src/flask/cli.py

plan.detail: Update @click.option type choices on line 992 from ('endpoint', 'methods', 'rule', 'match') to include 'domain', and update help text
plan.title: Add domain sort option to routes command

plan.detail: Replace the current string formatting approach (lines 1004-1034) with the upstream approach: 1) Detect if any rule has subdomain/host (has_domain check), 2) Build rows as lists instead of formatted strings, 3) Conditionally add Subdomain or Host column header based on has_domain and host_matching, 4) Use itemgetter for sorting by column index, 5) Calculate widths dynamically from row data, 6) Format output using template string
plan.title: Refactor routes_command to use row-based output
